title: A sales board in dbt Charts

ticket.subject: Monthly sales by category
body: Could we have a board in the repo, next to the models, instead of another spreadsheet?
- net sales per month as a bar or line chart;
- a filter on the product category;
- a table of the top products would be a bonus.
It must read the `fct_order_lines` model (not the raw tables), validate with `dct validate`, and I want
the rendered board for the Monday review: a PNG, and the JSON render so finance can check the numbers.
Build the models first: the board reads what dbt built.

acceptance.text: The board reads ref('fct_order_lines'), filters on category, and has a bar, line or area chart.
renders/sales.json has a chart whose values add up to the warehouse's net sales.

checks.total_sql: SELECT CAST(sum(net_amount) AS DOUBLE) AS total FROM dbt_dev_board.fct_order_lines

acceptance.text: renders/sales.png is there for the review.

requires.message: The models are not built yet: run dbt build first.

check.sql: SELECT count(*) > 0 AS built FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbt_dev_board' AND table_name = 'fct_order_lines'

hints: `dct docs getting-started` and `dct examples` work offline; `dct docs variables` covers filters.
In a board query, `{{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}` reads the dbt model through the project's manifest.
A select filter can take its options from a column (`column: table.column`); `{{ filter('name', name) }}` applies it.
The dbt Lab's Render buttons type `dct render charts/sales.yml --format png` (or json) for you.
